title: BACK DOOR GLASS
ocr_text:
BACK DOOR GLASS
COMPONENTS

Glass and Weatherstrip
Defogger
Wire Connector
Wiper Arm
Door Trim

REMOVAL OF BACK DOOR GLASS

1. REMOVE REAR SPOILER
(a) Remove the back door trim.
(b) Remove the eight nuts.
(c) Disconnect the high mount stop light wire connector.
(d) Lift up the rear end of the spoiler, slide it toward the front, and remove it.
(e) Remove the four clips from the spoiler.
